purpose: Select one genuinely distinct historical-only minute mechanism after Campaign049 without using any Campaign050 candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return value.
numbering_disambiguation: Historical Campaign050 is a research-campaign identifier and does not activate prospective Candidate50; Candidate49 remains the only prospective ledger.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether each half-session's single largest absolute one-minute close shock is directionally retraced by that half-session's terminal close. No frozen factor selects one endogenous extreme return in each half and scores its remaining same-half terminal retracement.
Pooling every adjacent return pair would restate terminal intraday_return_reversal_energy_share_236p.
Conditioning on all negative returns and their next moves would restate terminal intraday_negative_return_absorption_rate_236p and introduce a one-sided direction search.
Selecting a running peak-to-trough drawdown and terminal recovery would restate terminal afternoon_drawdown_recovery_resilience_120m.
Timing alone reopens extreme-arrival and amount-center families; amount weighting reopens activity-price coupling and lead-lag families.
A full-day winner would search across half-session definitions and admit the lunch transition; Campaign050 freezes two independent 119-return halves.

Campaign050 freezes earliest absolute-shock ties, one terminal retracement normalization, higher direction, and no alternative field, lag, window, threshold, filter, subset, weight, fit, model, or combination.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_half_session_extreme_shock_reversal_completion_2h
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Prompt directional retracement of the largest one-minute shock in both continuous half sessions is consistent with liquidity replenishment and completed price discovery rather than persistent inventory pressure, potentially leaving a more resilient close-known state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: Within each independent 120-close half-session form 119 adjacent log returns. Choose the earliest index k attaining the maximum absolute return, let s be that return, and let R=log(last_close_in_half/close_immediately_after_s). Define h=-2*s*R/(s^2+R^2). Return the arithmetic mean of the morning and afternoon h values.
selected_candidate.terminal_retracement_anchor: close immediately after the selected extreme return to the final close of the same half-session
selected_candidate.support_rule: All 240 closes must be finite and strictly positive; each half-session must contain at least one exactly nonzero log return; exact zero nonselected returns remain in the fixed support.
selected_candidate.normalization: negative twice the selected shock times its same-half terminal retracement divided by their squared Euclidean energy

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against the full 73-factor comparison chain, then freeze the exact ordered no-return protocol.
